verdict.rationale: Devin's API supports creating sessions programmatically (including on behalf of users) and scheduling recurring tasks, which enables automation across multiple items, and it can be tagged/delegated tasks from Slack, Jira, etc., but there's no documented bulk/batch operation primitive (e.g., 'process these 50 tickets' in one call) — each session appears to be single-task oriented and users must orchestrate bulk operations themselves via the API. missing for 10: native bulk/batch task submission API, evidence of parallel multi-item processing at scale, and independent confirmation of successful bulk workflows.
